seo.faq1a: SavePrompt is a free, minimalist web app that lets you save, organize, and quickly copy AI prompts. It works entirely in your browser with no account or server needed.
seo.faq2a: Yes! SavePrompt is a Progressive Web App (PWA). Install it on your device and use it anytime, even without an internet connection.
seo.faq3a: Absolutely. All prompts are stored locally on your device using your browser's localStorage. No data is ever sent to any server.
seo.faq4q: Can I export my saved prompts?
seo.faq4a: Yes. Use the Export JSON button to download a backup of all your saved prompts at any time.
seo.howToStep1: Type or paste your AI prompt into the text area
seo.howToStep2: Optionally add tags to organize your prompt
seo.howToStep3: Click Save to store it locally
seo.howToStep4: Use the Copy button to instantly copy any saved prompt
